properties.site-address: Land at Green Court Sports Club, Green Court Road, Crockenhill
properties.ownership-status: not owned by a public authority
properties.notes: The site comprises a sports club containing a club house, football pitch and area of hardstanding for car parking. Bounded by Green Court Road and residential development to the south, the A20 to the east, railway line to the north and open countryside to the west. Mature trees line the boundaries of the site.
